newsitem.title: INDIA: India's 96/97 trade deficit $2 bln - newspapers.
newsitem.headline: India's 96/97 trade deficit $2 bln - newspapers.

text.p: The Indian government estimates the nation's trade deficit in the 1996/97 fiscal year ending on March 31 will be some $2 billion compared with $4.5 billion in the preceding year, newspapers said on Thursday.
They quoted Commerce Secretary P.P. Prabhu as releasing the tentative 1996/97 estimate to reporters on Wednesday.
The trade deficit during April to November last year totalled $2.83 billion, compared with $3.30 billion over the same eight-month period in 1995.
